privacy_claims.publication_rule: A privacy change may be published only after the pinned notice has completed the required content review and its digest is recorded here.

release_claims.publication_rule: A recorded read-only Play Console observation is sufficient only for an availability claim about its exact version and track. Artifact provenance is sufficient only for a code-content claim about its exact version. A compound availability-and-content claim requires both gates. deployment.rule: A live artifact must be identified by a deployment manifest containing its source commit, artifact digest, verification record, and rollback reference; it is never inferred from branch names or similar markup.
